info.title: Caesura API
info.description:
The public REST API. Every endpoint takes an account API token as
`Authorization: Bearer tc_...`, minted in Account settings.

Scopes:
- `trips:read` — See your trips, their days and stops, costs, history, and existing share links.
- `trips:write` — Create, change and delete trips, days and stops; undo, redo and revert.
- `notebook:read` — Read the Notebook pages on a trip.
- `notebook:write` — Create, change and delete the Notebook pages on a trip.
- `library:read` — Read your saved-days library.
- `library:write` — Create and delete saved days, and publish or unpublish them to Discover.
- `sharing:write` — Invite people to a trip, revoke invites, remove members, and create or revoke share links.
- `account:read` — See who you are and what plan you hold.
